verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a mesh VPN and connectivity platform. Grouping terminal sessions and broadcasting commands to them is a terminal-emulator or SSH-client feature, so the story is outside its product category. Tailscale SSH (tailscale-docs-26) only manages authentication and authorization of SSH connections, and nothing in the pack shows Tailscale ships session grouping or command broadcast, so the axis is not flipped to applicable.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can group multiple terminal sessions together and broadcast the same command to all of them
